label: 2. I've gone over the materials you sent me.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: I've gone over the materials you sent me.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Your findings do seem to contradict the description given in IV's report.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I spoke with many of the target's acquaintances regarding

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: the accusations leveled against them.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I also personally traveled with the target for several days,

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: yet failed to uncover evidence that corroborated any of the statements contained within the Authorization.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Understood. The Judges are conducting their own internal investigation in regards to this matter.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: Given the surplus of discrepancies with this case, I've postponed the execution order.

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I also suggest there be a reappraisal of the target.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: The Judges do not want a target to be terminated in error, either.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: We accept your application.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: If what you are saying is true,

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: there will be a revote.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Either your or IV

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: is attempting to deceive us.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Only one of you can possibly be telling the truth.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Spreading falsehoods is an offense punishable by death.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: I take it you are aware of this?

lines.speaker: d
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: x
lines.text: Very well. We will contact you when everything is made clear.
